## 

```{r}
library(dagitty)
library(ggdag)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

# Create the DAG
dag <- dagitty('dag {
  Z1 [pos="0,0"]
  X [pos="1,1"]
  Y [pos="3,1"]
  Z2 [pos="2,2"]
  
  Z1 -> X
  Z1 -> Y
  X -> Z2
  Y -> Z2
}')

# Plot the DAG
ggdag(dag) + 
  theme_dag() +
  ggtitle("DAG: No Causal Path X → Y, but Z2 is a Collider")

# Simulate data
set.seed(42)
n <- 10000

# Z1 is a confounder
Z1 <- rnorm(n)

# X and Y are both caused by Z1, but X does NOT cause Y
X <- 0.8 * Z1 + rnorm(n, sd = 0.5)
Y <- 1.2 * Z1 + rnorm(n, sd = 0.5)

# Z2 is a COLLIDER - caused by both X and Y
Z2 <- 0.6 * X + 0.6 * Y + rnorm(n, sd = 0.5)

# Now let's examine the associations
cat("1. Marginal (unadjusted) association between X and Y:\n")
print(summary(lm(Y ~ X)))$coefficients[2, c(1,4)]

cat("\n2. Association adjusting for Z1 (the confounder):\n")
print(summary(lm(Y ~ X + Z1))$coefficients[2, c(1,4)])

cat("\n3. Association adjusting for Z2 (the collider):\n")
print(summary(lm(Y ~ X + Z2))$coefficients[2, c(1,4)])

cat("\n4. Association adjusting for both Z1 and Z2:\n")
print(summary(lm(Y ~ X + Z1 + Z2))$coefficients[2, c(1,4)])
```
```{r}
data <- tibble(X, Y, Z1, Z2)
ggplot(data, aes(x = X, y = Y)) +
  geom_point()
```
```{r}
# Base R version
plot(X, Y, 
     xlab = "X", 
     ylab = "Y",
     main = "Marginal (Unadjusted) Relationship Between X and Y",
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
abline(lm(Y ~ X), col = "blue", lwd = 2)

# Add the slope to the plot
cat("Marginal slope:", coef(lm(Y ~ X))[2], "\n")
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

df <- data.frame(X = X, Y = Y)

ggplot(df, aes(x = X, y = Y)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  labs(x = "X",
       y = "Y",
       title = "Marginal Relationship Between X and Y",
       subtitle = "Strong positive association due to confounding by Z1") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Added-variable plot: adjust both X and Y for Z1
resid_Y <- residuals(lm(Y ~ Z1))
resid_X <- residuals(lm(X ~ Z1))

# Plot the residuals
plot(resid_X, resid_Y, 
     xlab = "X (adjusted for Z1)", 
     ylab = "Y (adjusted for Z1)",
     main = "Scatterplot After Adjusting for Z1",
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.3))
abline(lm(resid_Y ~ resid_X), col = "red", lwd = 2)

# The slope of this line equals the coefficient from lm(Y ~ X + Z1)
cat("Slope from residual plot:", coef(lm(resid_Y ~ resid_X))[2], "\n")
cat("Coefficient from lm(Y ~ X + Z1):", coef(lm(Y ~ X + Z1))[2], "\n")
```
```{r}
library(broom)

# Get both models
fit_marginal <- lm(Y ~ X)
fit_adjusted <- lm(Y ~ X + Z1)

# Extract coefficients for X
coef_marg <- round(coef(fit_marginal)[2], 3)
coef_adj <- round(coef(fit_adjusted)[2], 3)
r2_marg <- round(summary(fit_marginal)$r.squared, 3)
r2_adj <- round(summary(fit_adjusted)$r.squared, 3)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Marginal plot
plot(X, Y, 
     main = paste0("Marginal\nβ = ", coef_marg, ", R² = ", r2_marg),
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3))
abline(fit_marginal, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

# Adjusted plot
resid_X <- residuals(lm(X ~ Z1))
resid_Y <- residuals(lm(Y ~ Z1))
plot(resid_X, resid_Y,
     xlab = "X (adjusted for Z1)", ylab = "Y (adjusted for Z1)",
     main = paste0("Adjusted for Z1\nβ = ", coef_adj, ", R² = ", r2_adj),
     pch = 16, col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.3))
abline(lm(resid_Y ~ resid_X), col = "red", lwd = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-four-plots
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-cap: "Comparison of marginal and adjusted associations"

# Get all models
fit_marginal <- lm(Y ~ X)
fit_adj_Z1 <- lm(Y ~ X + Z1)
fit_adj_Z2 <- lm(Y ~ X + Z2)
fit_adj_both <- lm(Y ~ X + Z1 + Z2)

# Extract statistics for each model
get_stats <- function(model) {
  coef_x <- round(coef(model)[2], 3)
  r2 <- round(summary(model)$r.squared, 3)
  p_val <- summary(model)$coefficients[2, 4]
  p_text <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", 
                   paste("p =", round(p_val, 3)))
  list(coef = coef_x, r2 = r2, p = p_text)
}

stats_marg <- get_stats(fit_marginal)
stats_Z1 <- get_stats(fit_adj_Z1)
stats_Z2 <- get_stats(fit_adj_Z2)
stats_both <- get_stats(fit_adj_both)

# Create 2x2 plot layout
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

# 1. Marginal plot
plot(X, Y, 
     main = paste0("Marginal (Unadjusted)\nβ = ", stats_marg$coef, 
                   ", R² = ", stats_marg$r2, ", ", stats_marg$p),
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3),
     xlab = "X", ylab = "Y")
abline(fit_marginal, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

# 2. Adjusted for Z1 only
resid_X_Z1 <- residuals(lm(X ~ Z1))
resid_Y_Z1 <- residuals(lm(Y ~ Z1))
plot(resid_X_Z1, resid_Y_Z1,
     main = paste0("Adjusted for Z1\nβ = ", stats_Z1$coef, 
                   ", R² = ", stats_Z1$r2, ", ", stats_Z1$p),
     xlab = "X (adjusted for Z1)", 
     ylab = "Y (adjusted for Z1)",
     pch = 16, col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.3))
abline(lm(resid_Y_Z1 ~ resid_X_Z1), col = "red", lwd = 2)

# 3. Adjusted for Z2 only
resid_X_Z2 <- residuals(lm(X ~ Z2))
resid_Y_Z2 <- residuals(lm(Y ~ Z2))
plot(resid_X_Z2, resid_Y_Z2,
     main = paste0("Adjusted for Z2\nβ = ", stats_Z2$coef, 
                   ", R² = ", stats_Z2$r2, ", ", stats_Z2$p),
     xlab = "X (adjusted for Z2)", 
     ylab = "Y (adjusted for Z2)",
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0.5, 0, 0.3))
abline(lm(resid_Y_Z2 ~ resid_X_Z2), col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2)

# 4. Adjusted for both Z1 and Z2
resid_X_both <- residuals(lm(X ~ Z1 + Z2))
resid_Y_both <- residuals(lm(Y ~ Z1 + Z2))
plot(resid_X_both, resid_Y_both,
     main = paste0("Adjusted for Z1 and Z2\nβ = ", stats_both$coef, 
                   ", R² = ", stats_both$r2, ", ", stats_both$p),
     xlab = "X (adjusted for Z1 and Z2)", 
     ylab = "Y (adjusted for Z1 and Z2)",
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0.3))
abline(lm(resid_Y_both ~ resid_X_both), col = "purple", lwd = 2)

# Reset plot layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# Print summary table
cat("\nSummary of Results:\n")
cat("==================\n")
cat(sprintf("%-20s β = %6.3f, R² = %.3f, %s\n", 
            "Marginal:", stats_marg$coef, stats_marg$r2, stats_marg$p))
cat(sprintf("%-20s β = %6.3f, R² = %.3f, %s\n", 
            "Adjusted for Z1:", stats_Z1$coef, stats_Z1$r2, stats_Z1$p))
cat(sprintf("%-20s β = %6.3f, R² = %.3f, %s\n", 
            "Adjusted for Z2:", stats_Z2$coef, stats_Z2$r2, stats_Z2$p))
cat(sprintf("%-20s β = %6.3f, R² = %.3f, %s\n", 
            "Adjusted for both:", stats_both$coef, stats_both$r2, stats_both$p))
```
